title: Power Rankings: Cavs hold on to top spot
heading: 2009-10 Power Rankings: Week 10
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: For all the grief Shaq gets about his pick-and-roll D, it hasn't really hurt the Cavs yet. They're giving up the league's fewest points in the paint since bringing Shaq in, and D has fueled Cleveland's surge to No. 1.
rankings.summaryText: For all the grief Shaq gets about his pick-and-roll D, it hasn't really hurt the Cavs yet. They're giving up the league's fewest points in the paint since bringing Shaq in, and D has fueled Cleveland's surge to No. 1.
